Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. We are trying to get a short, focused run-through of Redwood’s controls/traffic flow for an upcoming procurement review. Scope we need to touch on: a quick DPA confirmation, SOC 2 controls overview, and a 3rd-party pen-test logistics question. Can we keep this to a 45–60 minute slot?

Constraints on our side: several reviewers are in EST and one pen-test vendor (PenTestOps) will dial in from CET. Ideally we’d run something late in your day (PDT after 16:00) so it’s morning for our vendor, or alternatively early morning PDT works.

Attached is our preliminary questionnaire (FinPartner_Preliminary_Questions.pdf) — it highlights a few specific items we want to cover. Can you propose two windows? We prefer a compact agenda: 15m DPA, 30–40m SOC2/pen test handoff.

Thanks — appreciate if Kimberley (security lead) or someone on ops can join.

Alex Gomez

- Option B: Wed Apr 5, 2028 08:00–09:00 PDT (16:00–17:00 CET) — earlier day for us, late afternoon for CET

If you prefer a strict 45m, we can trim: 15m DPA; 30m SOC2 + pen-test logistics. I’m attaching our evidence mapping template so the DPA bit can be quick.

Agenda (draft):
- 0–15m: DPA confirmation & data flows
- 15–45m: SOC2 scope highlights + where evidence lives
- 45–60m: Pen-test logistics and vendor handoff (questions, scheduling)

If Option A works I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom link and a short agenda + Drive folder. Kimberly — can you confirm you or someone from SecOps can join Option A? Tessa — I’ll loop you for the CS handover.
